reminders.title: Tax and insurance reminders
reminders.intro: When a vehicle's road tax or insurance is due for renewal. The largest number also decides when it first shows on the dashboard.
reminders.daysHelp: Up to 10 numbers, separated by commas. For example 45, 30, 14, 7. Leave blank for no reminders.
reminders.digestHelp: One list of everything expiring that month.

pricing.title: Pricing and tax
pricing.intro: How the shop's prices are filled in, taxed and secured. Each product's own prices are on its Pricing tab.
pricing.firstSaveNote: Saving here for the first time fixes the shop's currency as {currency}. It can't be changed after that.
pricing.firstSaveConfirm: Saving fixes the shop's currency as {currency}, and it can't be changed after that. Save?

rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.intro: Quick entry rounds the days it fills in to this step. Prices already saved never change.

tax.title: Tax
tax.intro: Whether the prices you type include tax, and the tax most products charge.
tax.inclusiveHelp: The price a customer sees is what they pay; the tax is worked out inside it.
tax.exclusiveHelp: The prices you type are before tax; the tax is added to the total.
tax.noProfiles: Add a tax profile below to charge tax. Until then the shop charges no tax.
tax.defaultHelp: Used by every product set to "Shop default".

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.intro: What an order asks as a deposit. Never taxed or discounted.
deposit.noneHelp: Orders take no deposit. Deposits saved on vehicles are kept for later.
deposit.percent_of_orderHelp: Of the order's total after discounts, tax included.
deposit.fixed_per_orderHelp: The same amount however many vehicles.
deposit.per_productHelp: Each vehicle's own deposit, set on its Pricing tab, times how many.
deposit.shopAmountHelp: For a vehicle with no deposit of its own. Blank: none.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.label: Accept coupons
coupons.later: You will be able to create coupons in a later update.

profiles.title: Tax profiles

seasons.deleteConfirm: Delete this season? This can't be undone.

extras.intro: The rental gear and services offered with every vehicle of the shop.

Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.intro: {units, plural, =0 {No vehicles yet} one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} in {products, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}.
Fleet.searchPlaceholder: Product name, plate or frame number
Fleet.empty: No vehicles yet. Add a product on the Products page, then add your vehicles to it, or import them all from a CSV file.

import.title: Import vehicles from CSV
import.intro: One row per vehicle. The whole file is checked first: if any row has a problem, nothing is saved.
import.columnsHelp: “product” is required: the product’s name, as it is on your Products page. A name you don’t have yet creates the product: give “vehicle_type” (motorbike, car, atv, boat or other; blank means motorbike) and “category” (the choices are under Categories below; required for a motorbike or a car; for several, separate them with a semicolon, like “adventure; touring”). There is no make, model, engine size or transmission column: put the make, model and years in the product’s name or description if you want them. “year” is the vehicle’s own year. Leave “plate” blank for a vehicle without one yet. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; odometer is in {unit}; purchase price is in {currency}.
import.done: Imported {units, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} and {products, plural, =0 {no new products} one {# new product} other {# new products}}.
import.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} found. Nothing was imported.

choice.generalHelp: Rental gear, items for sale, services and extras.

general.typeLegend: What type of product is it?

typeHelp.gear: Lent out and returned: helmets, cameras, phone holders.
typeHelp.sale_item: Sold, not returned: stickers, shirts, hats.
typeHelp.service: Charged for, with no stock: cover, delivery, licence help.

general.name: Product name
general.nameHelp: One product per size for now: add Helmet S, Helmet M and Helmet L as three products.
general.trackUnits: Track each unit on its own
general.trackUnitsHelp: Each unit gets its own line, and a label if you want one. Leave it off to count them only.
general.quantityHelp: How many you have. You can change it later on the Stock tab.
general.serviceNote: A service has no quantity: it is always available.
general.pricesLater: Prices come in a later stage, and selling items comes with orders.

stockTab.quantityHelpSale: What you have on hand now. The change is kept in the stock history.
stockTab.noUnits: No units here yet. Set the quantity on the Details tab to add some.
stockTab.untrackedHint: These units are counted, not named. To give each one its own name or label, switch on “Track each unit on its own” under Product details, on the Details tab.
stockTab.untrackedHintStaff: These units are counted, not named. An owner or manager can switch on “Track each unit on its own” to give each one a name or label.
stockTab.label: Label (optional)
stockTab.ledgerIntro: Every change to what is on hand, newest first.
stockTab.serviceNote: A service has no stock: it is always available.

gearStock.summaryHelp: In stock counts units in use and in repair. Lost units are not counted.
gearStock.quantityHelp: Raising it adds units. Lowering it removes only free units, never ones in repair, lost or booked.
gearStock.reportIntro: For a unit that is in repair, lost, or damaged for good.
gearStock.reportNone: No unit is in use and free right now, so there is nothing to report.

kindHelp.repair: Being cleaned or repaired. Still counted in stock, but not available to rent until it is back in use.
kindHelp.lost: Missing. Not counted in stock and not available. It can be marked found later.
kindHelp.damaged: Can’t be repaired. Removed from this product for good.

gearStock.outIntro: Units in repair or lost. Each can still come back.
gearStock.writeOffConfirm: Remove from stock? This cannot be undone. The unit is removed from this product for good and can’t be marked found again. The History keeps a record.
gearStock.lostWaiting: An owner or manager marks it found or removes it from stock.
gearStock.dateHelp: For information only. It does not affect stock quantities.

extras.intro: The rental gear and services offered with this vehicle. Online bookings take up to the most per vehicle; staff can add more at the counter.
extras.introRead: The rental gear and services offered with this vehicle.
extras.everyIntro: Offered with every vehicle. A vehicle can set its own, or switch one off with "Not offered for this vehicle", on its Extras tab.
extras.everyNone: Nothing is offered with every vehicle yet.
extras.shopTitle: From the list for every vehicle
extras.shopIntro: Offered with this vehicle too, unless you switch it off here.
extras.shopNone: The shop offers nothing with every vehicle.
extras.shopLink: Settings › Extras: what every vehicle offers
extras.mostHelp: Online bookings take up to this many with each vehicle. Empty: no limit.
extras.addLabel: Add rental gear or a service
extras.unknown: A product that no longer exists
extras.noProducts: The shop has no rental gear or services yet. Add them on the Products page.
extras.readOnly: Only an owner or a manager can change extras.

Locations.timezoneWarning: Changing the time zone moves every opening hour and due date of this location. Save anyway?
Locations.hoursHelp: Leave both times blank on a day the location is closed.

Admin.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
Admin.mergeInto: It is the same bike as

Admin.notesHelp: If you reject, the shop sees this note on its model.
Admin.yearsHelp: The shop’s own bike is a {year}. Set the range of years before you approve.

reorder.help: Select and drag to move anywhere on the list, or use the arrows to move one row at a time

drag.instructions: Press Space to pick up. Then use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
drag.cancelled: Move cancelled. {name} is back at position {position} of {total}.

Pricing.readOnly: You can see these prices but not change them.

method.title: How it is priced
method.tieredHelp: A total for each length from 1 to 30 days; longer rentals by the month.
method.per_periodHelp: One amount per hour, day, week or month.
method.fixedHelp: One amount per order, however long.
method.freeHelp: Shown as included; nothing is charged.

flat.title: Flat fee
flat.help: Every started period is charged. A week is 7 days; a month runs date to date from the pickup.

fixed.title: Fixed price
fixed.help: Charged once per order, whatever the length.

free.title: Free
free.help: Shown as included on the order. Nothing is charged.

tiered.title: By rental length
tiered.ownHelp: Type up to six prices; the days between fill in.
tiered.sharedHelp: One list for several products. Change it once, every product on it follows.
tiered.noLists: There are no shared price lists yet.
tiered.baseHelp: This list holds multipliers. Each day's price is this base price × the day's multiplier.
tiered.longStayHelp: For each day after a whole month (rentals of 31 days or more). Blank: the monthly price ÷ 30.

quick.title: Quick price entry
quick.help: Daily and monthly are required. The days between fill in in equal steps; you can change any day below.
quick.helpMultipliers: Daily and monthly are required. Type multipliers, such as 3 or 1.1666. The days between fill in; you can change any day below.
quick.required: Daily and monthly are both needed.
quick.invalid: Enter an amount above 0, such as 300 or 300.50.
quick.invalidMultiplier: Enter a multiplier above 0, such as 3 or 1.1666.

grid.label: Price for each length
grid.fallsTitle: A longer rental can't cost less
grid.falls: {day} days cost less than {before} days. Raise it, or lower the days before it. Equal prices are fine.
grid.invalidDays: A day typed by hand isn't a valid price.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.help: Taken per vehicle on an order. Blank: the shop's amount; 0: no deposit.
deposit.shopAmount: Blank uses the shop's amount: {amount}. 0: no deposit for this one.
deposit.percent: The shop takes {percent} of each order as a deposit.
deposit.fixed: The shop takes {amount} per order as a deposit.

replacement.title: Replacement value
replacement.help: What a lost or broken item costs the customer.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.help: Seasons are set for the whole shop. They change the price for the part of a rental inside them.

check.title: Check a price
check.intro: Prices a sample rental with these prices.
check.introUnsaved: Prices a sample rental with the prices on screen, saved or not.
check.notPriced: Fill in the prices to check one.
check.cantPrice: This rental can't be priced. Check the dates and the quantity.
check.seasonDays: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} inside
check.depositHelp: Taken beside the total; never taxed.

basis.hours: {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} at {hourly}
basis.hoursCapped: {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, held to the 1-day price
basis.list: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from the price list
basis.months: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} and {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} at {rate} a day

lists.title: Price lists
lists.intro: Shared price lists. Each product on a list follows it.
lists.products: {count, plural, =0 {No products} one {# product} other {# products}}
lists.newIntro: Choose its kind, name it and enter its prices.
lists.name: Name
lists.nameHelp: For example 300–3000. Names are unique in the shop.
lists.kindAmountsHelp: The price for each length, in money.
lists.kindMultipliersHelp: Each product on it sets its own base price, which the list multiplies.
lists.kindFixed: A list's kind can't be changed.
lists.sampleBaseHelp: Shows what these multipliers come to at this base price.
lists.unused: No product uses this list yet.
lists.repriceNote: Saving changes the prices of {count, plural, one {this product} other {these # products}}:
lists.repriceConfirm: Saving changes the prices of {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}. Save?
lists.deleteConfirm: Delete this price list? This can't be undone.
lists.deleteBlocked: A list can't be deleted while a product uses it. Move those products to other prices first.
